description: Brand OS guard: keeps brand/*/options/ append-only and brand files valid. Trust it once with /hooks.

hooks.command: r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -f "$r/.agents/scripts/brand-guard.sh" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$r/.agents/scripts/brand-guard.sh" pre
r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -f "$r/.agents/scripts/brand-guard.sh" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$r/.agents/scripts/brand-guard.sh" post
